By assuming the answer in the very first step without verification, the Planner set a precedent that relied on pre-existing knowledge rather than the systematic gathering of information requested by the task instructions. Although the final answer was correct, the methodological error of not verifying the premise before proceeding constitutes a mistake in the reasoning process of the multi-agent system.
